title: Recovery of a low-degree Boolean function
statement: Let $n,\ell,m$ be natural numbers and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb F_2$ have algebraic degree at most $\ell$. If the $m$ sample inputs separate degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient families, then the function represented by the solver's output on the samples $(x,f(x))$ equals $f$ on all inputs.
hypotheses_covered: The algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $\ell$
The sample inputs separate degree-at-most-$\ell$ coefficient families
